Storey Publishing
Storey Publishing is the publisher of "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide," focusing on practical information for personal independence.

Leslie Carlson
Leslie Carlson is responsible for the text production of "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Grant Heilman Photography
Grant Heilman Photography holds the copyright for the cover photographs of "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Richard E. Bonne
Richard E. Bonne is the author of "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide," providing practical information about beekeeping.

Deborah Balmuth
Deborah Balmuth is an editor for "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Michelle Arabia
Michelle Arabia is credited with the cover and text design for "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Sandra Webb
Sandra Webb is an editor for "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Brigita Fuhrmann
Brigita Fuhrmann created the line drawings for "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Northwind Editorial Services
Northwind Editorial Services is responsible for indexing "Beekeeping: A Practical Guide."

Beekeeping: A Practical Guide
Beekeeping: A Practical Guide is a published work aimed at providing practical information about beekeeping.
